_about: THE PLACEMENT OF ENTRY B's PIECES (T573): one record per excluded item of a DFO row (pipeline.regs.dfo_salmon.closures.PieceGeometry) — a stretch between two cuts or a circle (centre + radius). PROPOSALS for the owner; nothing in the places files, the atlas or the feed reads this. Joined to the LIVE row by item key (closures.attach): a piece whose item DFO drops stays here, marked not live by the reader.

pieces.name: Deadman

pieces.name: Juniper
pieces.item: Juniper - from the fishing boundary signs approximately 1.5 km downstream from Juniper Beach Park downstream approximately 4 km to the fishing boundary signs located at 50°46.893' N and 121°08.110' W.
pieces.note: upper signs 4 km above DFO's printed lower signs: owner 2026-11-15 night, "if the book says 4km then we put it 4km unless i had another split it already matched??"; no cut exists at or near that spot (Thompson blk 356364690: lower signs m 93,016, upper m 97,016; nearest curated cuts m 81,551 and m 112,992; the atlas length break 'Battle Creek' at m 94,206 is a section break, not a sign), so a new cut

pieces.name: the water survey station to WTFB signs
pieces.item: closed from the water survey station (located at 50°19.105' N and 118°48.857' W) approximately 200 m down stream of Shuswap Falls Hatchery to WTFB signs (located at 50°18.181' N and 118°49.105' W) one km down stream
pieces.note: CHECK: DFO's printed points look SWAPPED against its words. The river flows north here (Shuswap Falls km 136.5 → Mabel Lake), so 'downstream' is north. The point printed for the water survey station (50°19.105' N) is the NORTH (downstream) one, at km 133.08; the point printed for the WTFB signs (50°18.181' N) is 27 m from WSC gauge 08LC003 'Shuswap River near Lumby' at km 135.13 — that is the water survey station. Between them is 2.05 km of river, not 'one km'. Stored as printed; the alternative end reads it as station → 1 km below.

pieces.name: Six Mile Creek
pieces.centre_from: Six Mile Creek is DFO's older name for Gullwing Creek: SkeenaWild's 2011 status report on Babine sockeye (from DFO's escapement database) lists the stock as 'Six Mile Creek (Gullwing Creek)', DFO's census site 615 is GULLWING CREEK, and it is the next named creek west of Four Mile Creek (local accounts fish '4 and 6 Mile creeks' together); no stream of the network or BC Geographic Names creek at the lake is named Six Mile. The centre: where its own channel (FWA blue line 360886655) meets the lake's outline; the in-lake connector line is not counted

pieces.name: east of a line from Gullwing Creek to south shore of Babine
pieces.item: east of a line from Gullwing Creek to south shore of Babine Lake
pieces.note: the owner's reading, 2026-11-16 (T796): "Due south". From Gullwing Creek's mouth on the north shore (FWA blue line 360886655, BC Geographic Names 4122; the same point as the Six Mile Creek circle) due south to the south shore at 54.45490, -125.36625 (3,356 m). DFO names no point on the south shore; the reading not taken was the shortest crossing (bearing 167, 2,975 m, to 54.45896, -125.35615, about 0.8 km east of this end). East of it: Gullwing Island, Four Mile Creek, Telzato Creek and the Sutherland River's mouth. T812: the lake is split on this line (added_lakes.geojson ids 24 / 25); the line closes the part east of it, Babine Lake — East of Gullwing Creek (wbk:-25).
